decision.observation: Wilson remains beside the visibly burning campfire at dusk. The cut grass has been consumed as fuel, and no immediate threats are visible.
decision.hypothesis: Waiting within the firelight should safely advance into night while preserving the two cooked berries.
decision.memory: All obvious fuel items have now been added to the campfire. Remaining supplies include 2 cooked berries, 1 Seeds, 3 pine cones, 1 Petals, and an axe at 75% durability.
